messages.author: Karis Jimenes
messages.body:
Hi, I want to ask you for help with Amber software installation. I already tried to install it on the system, but was unsuccessful. I was able to compile it with various versions of CUDA (11.8, 12.0, 12.1, 12.3 in environment modules) without errors but it still does not work correctly.
When running the program I have the error "cudaMemcpyToSymbol: SetSim copy to cSim failed no kernel image is available for execution on the device". Could you help me with this problem?
Thanks in advance for your help,

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Wed, Feb 07, 2024, Karis Jimenes via AMBER wrote:
>Hi, I want to ask you for help with Amber software installation. I already
>tried to install it on the system, but was unsuccessful. I was able to
>compile it with various versions of CUDA (11.8, 12.0, 12.1, 12.3 in
>environment modules) without errors but it still does not work correctly.
>
>When running the program I have the error "cudaMemcpyToSymbol: SetSim
>copy to cSim failed no kernel image is available for execution on the
>device". Could you help me with this problem?
We don't know exactly what you mean by "when running the program." Please
run "make test.cuda.serial" if you've not done so. That will run tests
against inputs known to be good, and will help determine the location and
extent of any problems that arise.
...dac
